motivation: The old H1-H11 strategy results were produced under materially different conditions, including the legacy alternating-lock arena and mostly 10k-node search.
The current stack uses Tetrp synchronous authority, corrected placement transport and garbage timing, H12-corrected DAG behavior, and a 200k-node review budget.
Therefore old H1-H11 results are treated as historical priors and hypothesis-generation evidence, not as current promotion or rejection verdicts.

fixed_current_stack.observation_boundary: own board/current/hold/exactly Next5/combo/B2B-Surge/observable pending garbage and own timing history only
fixed_current_stack.h13_product_note: Keep H13 correctness support for persistent interactive bot paths; do not use snapshot KO tests to judge H13 strength.
fixed_current_stack.compute_policy: H14 evidence is retained only as the basis for the provisional 200k product/search budget.

baseline_and_benchmark.benchmark_role: Reference checkpoint only. It is not the automatic promotion opponent.

old_hypothesis_policy.H1_to_H11: Re-screen under the current stack. Old good/bad labels do not carry forward as verdicts.
old_results_use: Prioritize which hypothesis families to test first.
Narrow sensible parameter ranges and avoid repeating obviously unproductive regions.
Identify plausible interactions and context-dependent redesigns.
Provide historical comparison only; do not pool old and new outcomes as one evidence set.

correctness_and_compute_exceptions.H12: Keep as corrected core behavior, not a strategy feature requiring re-promotion.
correctness_and_compute_exceptions.H13: Keep as correctness/product-path work; snapshot harness cannot provide meaningful strength evidence for it.
correctness_and_compute_exceptions.H14: Keep 200k as the provisional compute regime; H14 is not an evaluator feature.

stage_1_broad_rescreen.purpose: Cheap representative-value reconnaissance used only to prioritize the order of later multi-parameter family studies. It is not a family-elimination or promotion stage.
candidate_families: H2 useful outgoing attack / cancellation value
H3 B2B charge / Surge state value
interaction_only_history: H8 useful-attack x row-transition joint tuning
stage_1_broad_rescreen.interaction_policy: H7/H8 are not treated as standalone promoted features. Preserve them as interaction clues and revisit when the relevant base features exist in the new incumbent.

default_screen_design.pairing: Game A: candidate uses seed X, incumbent uses seed Y. Game B: candidate uses seed Y, incumbent uses seed X.
default_screen_design.independence_note: The two games in one asymmetric pair form one paired unit and must not be counted as two independent observations.
default_screen_design.reason: Avoid deterministic mirror locking such as the 5000-lock H1 cap behavior observed in run 35431278966.

stage_1_broad_rescreen.optional_extension: Historical note: the 8-pair screen was extended to 12 pairs for directional candidates. Under v2 these results remain prioritization evidence only.

screen_status_policy.priority_high: Small representative-value evidence suggests studying this family sooner.
screen_status_policy.priority_middle: Small representative-value evidence is flat or mixed; retain for later multi-parameter study.
screen_status_policy.priority_low: Small representative-value evidence is negative; defer expensive study, but do not reject the family.
screen_status_policy.finalist_candidate: A concrete parameter survives multi-parameter coarse sweep and fresh local refinement.
screen_status_policy.promoted: A fixed finalist passes a large fresh confirmation against the current incumbent.
screen_status_policy.retest_if_context_changes: A previously studied family or parameter may be revisited after incumbent, authority, search policy, compute budget, or a strongly interacting feature changes.

small_sample_rule.principle: Small representative-value results are a research-priority signal only. They must not eliminate an H-family or promote a parameter.
never_do: Do not delete or permanently reject a family because one representative parameter lost or tied in a small screen.
Do not interpret 8, 12, or 16 paired units as enough evidence to establish feature superiority when realistic effects may be modest.
Do not assume an old winning parameter or sign remains optimal under the current 200k Tetrp stack.
Do not promote or reject based on APP when KO points the other way.
retest_triggers: Search budget or search algorithm changes materially.
Authority, garbage timing, or observation boundary changes.
A newly promoted feature has a plausible interaction with the archived candidate.
The prior screen was close or internally mixed.
KO and diagnostics strongly disagree in a way that suggests a mechanism worth revisiting.
small_sample_rule.deep_freeze_guidance: Repeated, strongly negative current-stack results across sensible parameter choices may be assigned very low priority, but the evidence remains preserved rather than deleted.

stage_2_confirmation_and_lineage_growth.historical_note: The earlier plan moved representative-value winners directly toward 16-pair standalone confirmation. Under v2, that follow-up is retained only as ranking/diagnostic evidence.
stage_2_confirmation_and_lineage_growth.replacement: Use the multi-parameter family cycle: coarse sweep -> fresh local refinement -> fixed finalist -> large fresh confirmation -> sequential incumbent update.

historical_run_handling.whole_profile_transfer_and_confirmation: Retain as evidence that the old tuned package contains useful signal under Tetrp authority, but not as proof that each old component remains beneficial.
historical_run_handling.single_component_ablation_run_3543127896: Retain as partial historical evidence and as the reason to avoid symmetric same-seed evaluation. Do not use the four H1 caps as wins, losses, or draws.

next_action: Pause strength tuning. Repair and validate the Tetrp/Kiwi public rule contract first; then restart affected H2 research with fresh seeds under the repaired real-TL rules.

process_revision.name: parameter-search-first lineage v2
process_revision.supersedes: Using single representative-value small screens as feature promotion/rejection evidence.
process_revision.core_principle: The completed 8/12-pair representative-value screens, and the currently running 16-pair follow-up, are prioritization evidence only. They rank which hypothesis families receive expensive study first; they do not eliminate a family and cannot promote a feature.
reason: The current representative screens have too few paired experimental units to reliably distinguish modest effects.
A single historical parameter value cannot establish whether the broader hypothesis family contains a useful region under the new 200k Tetrp stack.

Old experiments used substantially larger multi-parameter screens, fresh validation, and often 200 paired seeds / 400 games for fixed-finalist confirmation; that experimental discipline should be retained while replacing the old arena and compute regime.

family_research_policy.coverage: Every standalone H-family remains eligible for a current-stack multi-parameter study. Small-sample flat or negative results change priority, not eligibility.
family_research_policy.priority_source: Use the representative-value broad screen and follow-ups only to choose study order. Current leading priority is H9/H2/H4, but later families are not rejected.

cycle.purpose: Search the family, not just the old winner.
cycle.design: Test multiple parameter values against the current incumbent using the same fresh asymmetric seed pairs for all values in that family.
cycle.default_target: About 20 paired units / 40 games per parameter value unless compute cost or a preregistered design justifies another size.
cycle.range_rule: Historical results may narrow or densify the range, but must not restrict the search to the old winning sign or exact value. Include the neutral/default value and both sides when the parameter semantics make both directions meaningful.
cycle.interpretation: This stage identifies promising regions only; it cannot promote the family.

cycle.purpose: Resolve the promising region found in the coarse sweep with fresh seeds and denser nearby values.
cycle.default_target: About 40 fresh paired units / 80 games per refined value or finalist candidate, preregistered before outcomes are inspected.
cycle.interpretation: Choose a fixed finalist from fresh evidence. Do not reuse the refinement data as final promotion evidence.

cycle.purpose: Determine whether the fixed parameter is reliably better than the current incumbent.
cycle.default_target: Target roughly 200 fresh paired units / 400 games for actual promotion evidence, comparable in sample scale to the stronger historical confirmations.
requirements: Fixed parameter and decision rule before results.
KO is the primary outcome; APP remains diagnostic.
No promotion from the earlier small or medium screens alone.

family_research_policy.sequential_incumbent_rule: If a finalist passes large confirmation, add it to the incumbent. The next H-family must then perform its own parameter search against that new incumbent rather than inheriting an optimum selected against an older baseline.
family_research_policy.parameter_point_rule: A weak result for one parameter value rejects only that tested point under that context, not the entire H-family.
family_research_policy.compute_efficiency: Not every parameter value receives 200-pair confirmation. Broad values get moderate samples; only a fixed finalist earns the expensive large confirmation.

interaction_policy_v2.H7_H8: Treat H7/H8 as interaction studies rather than standalone families. Run them when their relevant base features exist in the current incumbent or when a concrete interaction hypothesis becomes relevant.
interaction_policy_v2.resurrection: After meaningful incumbent changes, previously lower-priority families may be re-screened/researched because marginal value and optimal parameters can change through interactions.

current_small_sample_runs.interpretation: All of these are retained as ranking/diagnostic evidence. The ongoing 16-pair / 32-game run must not be called a promotion confirmation under the v2 policy, regardless of its outcome.

rule_parity_pause.blocking_issue: The authority/search stack used b2bcharge_base=0 while real TL replay evidence used b2bcharge_base=3. Public replay rules were not fully transported into the bot root.
rule_parity_pause.affected_evidence: All current-stack H9/H2 strength evidence collected before the rules contract is repaired remains evidence for the base=0 context only. It must not promote a real-TL product profile.
rule_parity_pause.current_h2_local_disposition: Allow the already-running job to finish for diagnostics only. It cannot select or promote a finalist.
resume_gate: Transport the relevant public TL attack/rule contract into every Kiwi/search root instead of relying on hidden defaults.
Run rule-parity regressions for Surge base/threshold, opener double-cancel boundary, attack multiplier, PC/garbage-special behavior, and Hold-locked root behavior.
Verify the research harness explicitly runs the intended real-TL rule profile.
Re-run authority/correctness gates before any new strength experiment.
Restart affected family research with fresh seeds under the repaired rule contract.
